Improves accuracy of getmempoolinfo and -maxmempool enforcement for node operators
reviewability: Review now: small, self-contained fix with a test that fails without it, already reviewed and tested
agreement: Strong support: tested ACK after verifying the memory delta and running related functional tests (jeanpablojp)
